body_markdown:
World of Warcraft The War Within is nearing it's end, and it feels surreal that this will be the last season before the Midnight DLC.


The brand-new expansion will be released sometime in 2026, and we'll be going over all the pre-order options that players have.


## World of Warcraft Midnight Pre-Order Guide: All Editions, Bonuses and More


WoW Midnight is aiming to re-invent World of Warcraft in many fascets as not only are there major changes coming to all 39 specializations in the game; but the addition of Player Housing is a breath of fresh air.


However, none of this matters unless you intend on purchasing Midnight; and if you're lokoing to pre-order the DLC, then we're going to run over all of the options below.


---


World of Warcraft: Midnight Base Edition - $49.99 USD


- World of Warcraft: The War Within


- World of Warcraft: Midnight


- Level 80 Character Boost


- 500 Trader's Tender


- Early Player Housing Access


World of Warcraft: Midnight Heroic Edition - $69.99 USD


- World of Warcraft: The War Within


- World of Warcraft: Midnight


- Level 80 Character Boost


- 1000 Trader's Tender


- Early Player Housing Access


- Lightstider Raiment Transmog Set


- Lightwing Dragonhawk Skyriding Mount


World of Warcraft: Midnight Epic Edition - $89.99 USD


- World of Warcraft: The War Within


- World of Warcraft: Midnight


- Level 80 Character Boost


- 2000 Trader's Tender


- Early Player Housing Access


- Lightstider Raiment Transmog Set


- Lightwing Dragonhawk Skyriding Mount


- Hopeflutter Pet


- Doomfeathers Pet


- 30 Days of Game Time


- 3 Days Early Access to Midnight


- Midnight Housing Bundle:


- Light-infused Rotunda (Light Gazebo)


- Void-Corrupted Rotunda (Void Gazebo)


- Light-Infused Fountain


- Void-Corrupted Fountain


- Alleria Portrait - "The Ranger-General" (Decor)


- Turalyon Portrait - "The High Exarch" (Decor)


- Arator Portrait - "The Redeemer" (Decor)


- Xal'atath Portrait - "The Harbinger" (Decor)
